title: Marketplace Orders Replacement Programme Terms
content:
**Terms.** A replacement is available only on Marketplace Orders delivery options that offer replacements. A replacement may be shipped instead of an item refund when the return reason is damaged in transit, defective or wrong item and the request is made within the replacement request window counted in calendar days from the delivered date, or when the shipment is undeliverable for loss or destruction. No more than the option's replacement maximum may be shipped per order.

**Retired clauses.** The following former clauses are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis:

- "A replacement and an item refund are mutually exclusive for the same units: once one is booked, the other is not."
- "Except for a lost package, the original unit must receive its first carrier scan within the option's unreturned replacement days after the replacement ships; otherwise the buyer is charged the item price of the replaced units as an unreturned-replacement item capture."

## Eligibility read from the order record

| Condition | Record that shows it | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Option offers replacements | the order's delivery option | Fulfilled by Northloop Standard, Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day or Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day |
| Replacement maximum not reached | replacements already recorded on the order over its lifetime | the count is below the option's replacement maximum |

## When a replacement may be shipped instead of an item refund

| Basis | Additional condition |
|---|---|
| return reason damaged in transit, defective or wrong item | the request is made within the replacement request window, counted in calendar days from the delivered date |
| shipment undeliverable for loss or destruction | none beyond the option offering replacements |

### Hypothetical case

A hypothetical order on Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, delivered on 2 April, with a 30-day request window, may have a replacement for a defective unit requested through 2 May. A second replacement on the same order is not shipped where the option's maximum is 1. The dates are example inputs.

superseded_clauses: A replacement and an item refund are mutually exclusive for the same units: once one is booked, the other is not.

Except for a lost package, the original unit must receive its first carrier scan within the option's unreturned replacement days after the replacement ships; otherwise the buyer is charged the item price of the replaced units as an unreturned_replacement_item capture.
